data.name: Vincent
data.gender_notes: Vincent is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin vincere, 'to conquer' — 'conquering'. Its root is Latin vincere. Saint Vincent de Paul. Vincent is a Latin name meaning “Conquering; prevailing”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vincent expresses “Conquering; prevailing”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vincent total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

biblical_reference.note: The name Vincent is not directly mentioned in the Bible, but its components 'vin' (wine) and 'cent' (hundred) have biblical references (e.g., Leviticus 10:9, John 2:1-11)
